rule: Only a reproduced MIR 3 defect may enter the terminal product set; platform generalization without a reproducer remains MIR 4 work.

surfaces.current_contract: Research packs are resolved through the target-aware general item prototype lookup, constrained by actual lab inputs, and exercised with a target-shaped item/tool science-pack fixture.
RecipeFactV2 retains normalized category sets; the exact Factorio 2.1 repair converts category plus additional_categories into categories before facts are captured.
Declared and effective independent/shared probability, ranges, extra-count, catalyst, and productivity exclusions are retained; unsafe automatic generation fails closed.
Quality-aware effect identities and target contracts preserve quality targets; missing quality targets are pruned while valid targets remain.
Recycling, self-return, and positive-loop safety are hard gates distinct from optional generated-recycler throughput controls; visible recycling recipes are not rewritten.
Existing trigger technologies may participate in graph reachability, but MIR-generated multi-level technologies are unit/count-formula designs and never copy research_trigger.
MIR captures finalized data-stage facts, sanitizes exact reviewed dangling references, and checks planned graph/live-prototype parity against later mutation.

boundary: The audit does not broaden public compatibility claims and does not substitute static inspection for exact load, upgrade, or interactive qualification.
